entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to start a return for a VeloBand Pulse.
Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. To pull up your account, can I get your full name and order number?
Jane Doe, order number is VF78-99-012.

Thank you, Jane. One moment... Okay, I see the VeloBand Pulse, delivered on December 15th. Before we proceed, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Neither. I don't want it. I tried to do this online over a week ago but your system was down. I just need the return label.
I understand. I do apologize for any trouble with the website. You mentioned it was down, can you recall what happened?

Yes, on January 2nd. I went to the return portal and got a big 'website error' message. Said the whole system was down for maintenance. I even took a screenshot. I couldn't get a QR code, I couldn't print a label, nothing worked.

Ah, yes. I see a note about that outage. We did have a server issue that day that took the returns portal offline for several hours. My apologies, that's completely our fault. Let me just confirm the policy for you.
Okay, looking at the account... the item was delivered on December 15th. Our return policy is 90 days from the date of delivery, so you're well within the timeframe.
Good. So you can email me the label?
Absolutely. I have just processed the return authorization. The pre-paid shipping label is on its way to your email address on file right now. You should receive it within the next 5 to 10 minutes.
Okay, great. That's all I needed. Thanks.
You're very welcome, Jane. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
